summary: Reviewed rules deployed after 27 security tests and browser integration checks; live denied requests verified. The existing official administrator document was preserved.

findings.issue: Firestore rules consult live profile authority but cannot immediately invalidate an already issued Auth token solely because Auth is disabled or deleted.
findings.recommendation: Use trusted owner procedures to revoke profile access before disabling or deleting an identity.

findings.issue: Owner authorization and mailbox verification are external procedures; the existing approved Chairperson profile currently grants authority without an email_verified gate.
findings.recommendation: Keep club administrator provisioning and maintenance restricted to trusted IAM owners. Do not infer owner approval from a display-name field.

findings.issue: Approved members intentionally read other approved profiles and relevant attendance. Profile streams remain unpaginated for the club-sized roster.
findings.recommendation: Revisit privacy and pagination as the roster grows; retain session-scoped event and event-scoped attendance queries.
